subject: Architecture
title: Notre-Dame de Paris: Stone and Faith
description: One-minute skill: Notre-Dame de Paris: Stone and Faith.

hook.text: Construction of Notre-Dame began in 1163. It took 182 years to finish.

buildup.text: Generations of builders worked on it, each adding their own style to the evolving design.

discovery.text: Its rose windows are 43 feet across — among the largest stained glass pieces ever made.

twist.text: By the 1800s, Notre-Dame was nearly demolished. Victor Hugo's novel saved it from destruction.

climax.text: The 2019 fire destroyed the spire and roof but the stone vaults held and protected the interior.

punchline.text: Eight centuries of history. Burned but not beaten.

quiz.question: What saved Notre-Dame from demolition in the 1800s?
options: Victor Hugo's novel about the cathedral
